name: denzo-music
description: Denzo Music - High-performance Audio Streaming Web Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run start:dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
